other: Gives herself, {id:10316}, and {id:11017} {st:WedgeOffice} if at least two of them are fielded for some offense level and damage. It also gives her power increases on her skills.
Prevents death once and heals herself for 50% hp.
Triggers {st:ComboSkill} with {id:11216} when he uses {skill:11216|05} for more damage and an additional {st:ComboWedgeDawn}.

Triggers {st:FusionVibration} into {st:VibrationCollapse} and {st:VibrationIgnition} with {skill:11116|06} and {skill:11116|08}. Since {st:FusionVibration} expires at the end of the turn, try using these when she's faster than most of your other sinners and line up as many {st:VibrationExplosion}s as you can.
usage: Builds {st:ComboWedge} passively when allies use skills and when Wedge or Dawn Office ids win clashes. At 25+, she consumes 25 to use {skill:11116|05} which gives her 1 {st:ComboWedgeDawn}. She also gains {st:ComboWedgeDawn} from her S3. {id:10316} and {id:11017} also give her more {st:ComboWedge} and {st:ComboWedgeDawn} with their own mechanics. At 4 {st:ComboWedgeDawn} she generates a free {skill:11116|06}. At 5 she generates a free {skill:11116|08} instead.
Her different S3 variations trigger {st:ComboSkill} with all Dawn and Wedge Office ids and she builds her statuses faster with them, so ideally bring the full team if you want to maximize her.

1111601.desc:
Increase the Stagger Threshold raise by +10% for [VibrationExplosion] triggered by this unit's Skills
Combat Start: Gain 1 [PenetrateResultUp] and 1 [PenetrateDamageUp]
1111601.flavor:
There is only so much piercing power to be gained from sharpening a spearhead. Spears forged from Patented alloys or rare materials recovered from the Ruins may offer greater results, but their price can rival several years' worth of an ordinary Fixer Office's budget. A far more economical approach is to harness the surrounding currents of wind and coil them around the weapon, granting it formidable piercing power at a fraction of the cost. The technique is well-established, with many Workshops offering their own implementations.
Wedge Office's spears are the handiwork of one such Workshop. Combined with the Office's distinctive spearwork, which makes masterful use of twisting and rotational movements, these weapons have run countless foes through.
1111601.name: Wedge-style Spearmanship

1111602.desc:
In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, apply the following effects (once per Encounter):
- Nullify that damage; then, this unit's HP cannot drop below 1 for the turn
- Turn End: Heal 50% HP
- Take -20% damage for this Encounter
1111602.name: Unrelenting

1111603.desc: Turn Start: If there are 2+ allied "Wedge Office[TabExplain]" Identities (including this unit) on the field, apply [WedgeOffice] Stack on all allied "Wedge Office[TabExplain]" Identities equal to the number of the said Identities on the field
1111603.name: Wedge Office

1111604.desc:
On Skill Use by an allied Identity (including this unit), gain 1 [ComboWedge] (once per turn per Identity)
On Clash Win by an allied "Wedge Office[TabExplain]" or "Dawn Office[TabExplain]" Identity, gain 2 [ComboWedge] (once per turn per Identity)

At this unit's Attack End, if this unit has 25+ [ComboWedge], use "Assume Wedge Formation" (once per turn)
1111604.flavor:
Most Fixer Offices work together to make up for one another's shortcomings.

Some Offices, however, find themselves so perfectly in sync that their partnership grows into something more. As they exchange information and forge deeper bonds of trust, they may eventually come to regard one another as siblings.
1111604.name: Assistance of the Wedge
